objects.title: OPFOR crossing of PHASE LINE ODIN detected
objects.body: ISR assets report battalion-sized element crossing in sector 2. Triggers INTSUM and fires request. BLUFOR must confirm, produce INTSUM-01, and coordinate counter-fires within 2 hours.
objects.expectedResponse: INTSUM production, fires request, sector 2 reinforcement order

objects.title: Cyber attack on HQ communications node
objects.body: Primary C2 link degraded to 30% capacity. Backup PACE plan must be activated within 4 hours. SATCOM link also degraded by adversary EW activity.
objects.expectedResponse: PACE plan activation, J6 incident report, C2 continuity procedures

objects.title: IDP column blocks Route AMBER
objects.body: Approximately 4,200 IDPs moving west along Route AMBER — the primary supply route. CIMIC and MP coordination required to establish bypass route and IDP holding area.
objects.expectedResponse: CIMIC coordination order, MP tasking, J4 re-routing of resupply convoy

objects.title: Weather degradation — reduced air support window
objects.body: Ceiling at 300ft. All CAS sorties cancelled for 18-hour period. Ground-based fires only. Division must replan fire support for ongoing deliberate attack.
objects.expectedResponse: Fire support plan revision, JTAR amendment, artillery re-tasking

objects.title: OPFOR SOF element identified in rear area
objects.body: HUMINT report of 6-person team targeting fuel depot at grid 541 882. Counter-SOF response required within 2 hours before team completes recce.
objects.expectedResponse: Counter-SOF tasking, force protection order amendment, J2 HUMINT exploitation

objects.title: Political event — NATO FM emergency session
objects.body: New ROE issued following political decision at NATO HQ. Division must implement updated ROE within 6 hours and disseminate to all subordinate units.
objects.expectedResponse: ROE dissemination order, legal review, commander's guidance to subordinates

objects.title: Logistics crisis — fuel reserves at 15%
objects.body: Resupply convoy delayed 48 hours by OPFOR interdiction. Fuel reserves across the division at 15%. Combat power vs sustainment trade-off decision required at division level.
objects.expectedResponse: J4 priority allocation order, combat power reduction plan, emergency resupply request

objects.title: OPFOR ceasefire offer — information operation
objects.body: Media reports ceasefire proposal attributed to OPFOR commander. STRATCOM and legal must respond within 3 hours. Assessed as likely IO deception to slow BLUFOR advance.
objects.expectedResponse: STRATCOM response line, legal assessment, J2 deception analysis
